name: Cloud Boundary Call
formation: Cloud Shell vs Gun 2x1 Boundary Left

summary.motive: Bait the boundary rhythm throw by disguising which defender owns the deep half, then exchange roles at the snap so the hot answer lands in coverage.
summary.keyDefender: SS flashing down from his disguised half alignment — he is the one waiting in the flat the QB was promised
summary.whyItWorks: The pre-snap picture shows a soft corner over the slot; the exchange means that window is actually the safest-covered spot on the field.
summary.failureMode: A deep over route through the vacated intermediate zone behind the dropping safety before MIKE can widen.

beats.title: 1. The Soft-Boundary Disguise
beats.text: The boundary corner sits at 7 yards looking beatable while his safety floats like a deep-half player — a picture built to invite the rhythm throw.

beats.title: 2. The Cloud Exchange
beats.text: At the snap the corner spins and bails while the safety breaks downhill — they swap responsibilities so smoothly the QB’s key never changes color.

beats.title: 3. Quick Out Into a Waiting Flat
beats.text: The H out is thrown exactly where a soft corner should be, only to find the exchanging safety sitting on the flat landmark with eyes on the QB.

beats.title: 4. Pick in the Boundary Flat
beats.text: The interception is secured as the bailed corner caps the vertical behind it — both halves of the exchange cashing on one snap.

relations.tell: The boundary corner lines up at 7 yards instead of the base call’s 10-yard squat — base Tampa 2 never gives its corner that much cushion to the slot side.
